cvs: 'Compactus' – smaller, 0.5–1 m (RHS) · 'Fire Ball' – rounded, bright red · the species – same size, narrower wings
foliage: deciduous; small elliptic mid-green leaves turning brilliant red in autumn
hardinessNote: Hardy in most of the UK, approximately −20 to −15°C (RHS 280088).
pollination: not applicable; grown for foliage and stems, and fruits form without a partner
prune: Little needed. Remove crossing or misplaced shoots in late winter to keep a good shape.
resilience: Tough and wind tolerant. Colours best in sun. Pests: occasional aphids, and spindle ermine moth caterpillars webbing the shoots.
sources: RHS 280088, Euonymus alatus 'Blade Runner': H6, 1.5–2.5 m × 1.5–2.5 m in 10–20 years; description to 1.5 m, broad corky wings, crimson autumn leaves, reddish-purple fruit with orange seeds (search snippets)
RHS 6969, Euonymus alatus: harmful if eaten; ASPCA burning bush toxic to dogs, cats, horses (2026-10-19 second pass)
Coolings, Gardening Express, Promesse de Fleurs: about 1.5 m, to 1.8 m at maturity
toxicity: All parts, especially the fruits and seeds, are toxic if eaten and can cause vomiting and diarrhoea. Keep away from children, dogs and cats.
uncertain: name: Oscar's label read 'Euonymus alatus Runner'; Oscar confirmed 2026-10-20 it is 'Blade Runner'.
size: RHS ultimate 1.5–2.5 m × 1.5–2.5 m; the same page's description says to 1.5 m and retailers 1.5–1.8 m, so it often stays at the low end.
peak: RHS gives autumn colour; Sep-Nov mapped from the season, as on the species card.
cvs: 'Fire Ball' is RHS-listed (H6); its description is from retail listings.
ratings, aspect, sunMin, water and prune: from the Forge draft and the species card, not sourced for the cultivar.
uses: Specimen shrub · mixed borders · informal hedging · autumn colour · winter stem interest
visual: Broad corky wings on the stems · toothed leaves turn rich crimson in autumn · small reddish-purple fruits split to show orange seeds
water: Water regularly in the first season. Once established it needs watering only in prolonged dry spells.
